What we lend against

The watches we lend against

We lend against the watches collectors actually own and intend to keep — modern and vintage, dress and sport, complications and everyday pieces. Box and papers help the valuation, but they’re not essential.

Rolex, Patek Philippe and Audemars Piguet

The pieces we lend against most — Submariner and Daytona, Nautilus and Aquanaut, Royal Oak and beyond.

Omega, Cartier, Breitling and more

Established makers with strong resale — Speedmaster, Santos, Tank, Navitimer.

Vintage and rare

Older references and limited pieces, valued on their own merit by specialists who know the market.

With or without box and papers

Missing the box or papers doesn’t rule a watch out — it’s one factor in the valuation, not a dealbreaker.

How it works

Four steps. Back on your wrist at the end.

Step 01

Tell us about your watch

Send the make, model and a few photos. A specialist values it and sends an indicative offer the same day.

Step 02

Send it to us, insured

Free, fully insured delivery — or bring it to our City of London office by appointment. Insured from the moment it leaves your hands.

Step 03

Accept the offer and get paid

Once we’ve seen the watch in person we confirm the valuation. Accept, and the money is with you within 24 hours.

Step 04

Repay, and it’s back on your wrist

Loans run for six months and can be extended. Repay early and you pay less, with no penalty. Your watch is returned exactly as you left it.

How we value watches

Valued by watch specialists, against the market

Every watch is assessed by a specialist — then valued against current market prices for that exact model. We don’t weigh it and guess, and we don’t treat a collector’s piece as scrap. Our specialists come from auction houses and the trade.

Authenticated

Reference, movement and originality of parts, checked by hand.

Priced to the market

Valued against live market prices for the exact model — not a generic estimate.

Box & papers weighed in

Condition and provenance factored in — helpful, never required.

Nothing sight-unseen

You see the valuation before you commit to anything.

Why Trinity rather than the high street

A pawnbroker for watches you intend to keep.

We-buy-any-watch and cash-for-watch services buy your watch outright. We don’t. A pawn loan is a loan — you keep ownership, we keep it safe, and you take it back when you repay.
